xna-type.name: BlendState
xna-type.summary: Contains blend state for the device.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of the BlendState class with default values, using additive color and alpha blending.

exceptions.exception: There is not enough memory to create this resource.

constructor.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: AlphaBlendFunction
property.summary: Gets or sets the arithmetic operation when blending alpha values. The default is BlendFunction.Add.
property.value: A value from the BlendFunction enumeration.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: AlphaDestinationBlend
property.summary: Gets or sets the blend factor for the destination alpha, which is the percentage of the destination alpha included in the blended result. The default is Blend.One.
property.value: A value from the Blend enumeration.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: AlphaSourceBlend
property.summary: Gets or sets the alpha blend factor. The default is Blend.One.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: BlendFactor
property.summary: Gets or sets the four-component (RGBA) blend factor for alpha blending.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: ColorBlendFunction
property.summary: Gets or sets the arithmetic operation when blending color values. The default is BlendFunction.Add.
property.value: A value from the BlendFunction enumeration.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: ColorDestinationBlend
property.summary: Gets or sets the blend factor for the destination color. The default is Blend.One.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: ColorSourceBlend
property.summary: Gets or sets the blend factor for the source color. The default is Blend.One.
property.remarks: For more information about blending, see What Is Color Blending? .

property.name: ColorWriteChannels
property.summary: Gets or sets which color channels (RGBA) are enabled for writing during color blending. The default value is ColorWriteChannels.None.
property.value: Any value from the ColorWriteChannels enumeration.

property.name: ColorWriteChannels1
property.summary: Gets or sets which color channels (RGBA) are enabled for writing during color blending. The default value is ColorWriteChannels.None.
property.value: Any value from the ColorWriteChannels enumeration.

property.name: ColorWriteChannels2
property.summary: Gets or sets which color channels (RGBA) are enabled for writing during color blending. The default value is ColorWriteChannels.None.
property.value: Any value from the ColorWriteChannels enumeration.

property.name: ColorWriteChannels3
property.summary: Gets or sets which color channels (RGBA) are enabled for writing during color blending. The default value is ColorWriteChannels.None.
property.value: Any value from the ColorWriteChannels enumeration.

property.name: MultiSampleMask
property.summary: Gets or sets a bitmask which defines which samples can be written during multisampling. The default is 0xffffffff.
property.value: A bitmask which defines multisample write locations.
property.remarks: Each bit enables writing to a multisample location. As an example, the first 8 bits enable the first eight samples for an 8-sample render target. The mask has no effect when not multisampling.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

field.name: Additive
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for additive blend, that is adding the destination data to the source data without using alpha.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: ColorSourceBlend = Blend.One, AlphaSourceBlend = Blend.One, ColorDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha, AlphaDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha,

field.name: AlphaBlend
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for alpha blend, that is blending the source and destination data using alpha.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: ColorSourceBlend = Blend.One, AlphaSourceBlend = Blend.One, ColorDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha, AlphaDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha,

field.name: NonPremultiplied
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for blending with non-premultipled alpha, that is blending source and destination data using alpha while assuming the color data contains no alpha information.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: ColorSourceBlend = Blend.SourceAlpha, AlphaSourceBlend = Blend.SourceAlpha, ColorDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha, AlphaDestinationBlend = Blend.InverseSourceAlpha,

field.name: Opaque
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for opaque blend, that is overwriting the source with the destination data.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: ColorSourceBlend = Blend.One, AlphaSourceBlend = Blend.One, ColorDestinationBlend = Blend.Zero, AlphaDestinationBlend = Blend.Zero,
